Mag Loader

You prepare your magazines before stepping out and check the feed without wasted motion. Even with numb fingers, the drill stays the same: round, check, next.
 
%c[ui_gray_3]EFFECTS:
%c[ui_gray_2]Five ranks improve loading and unloading speed. Ranks 4 and 5 add magazine slots to the equipped outfit.
 
Bonuses are totals for the selected rank. +100% speed means twice as fast, not instant. Speed multiplies the MCM setting. Magazine capacity is unchanged.
 
%c[d_red]REQUIRES GAMMA Mags Reloaded Forked v1.05 by AndTheHeroIs & Priler. Animations also require Animated Magazine Loading v0.9 Beta by SkyKi and the matching Absolute RPG installer option.
